desktopHero.title: Course Report with docked map
desktopHero.caption: One screen answers 'is the course healthy?': status counts and area rows on top, a live station map below, and the activity feed docked right.

desktopHero.title: Watering Plan with map and projected flow
desktopHero.caption: The table, the map and a projected-flow preview share one view, so an adjustment can be judged against its hydraulic effect before it is made.
desktopHero.flag: course name visible: Spyglass Hill (header and 'Spyglass Hill Adjust' label)

desktopHero.title: Projected Flow
desktopHero.caption: Stacked program colors turn a night of irrigation into one readable shape, with the course map underneath to show what is running where.
desktopHero.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club; course name visible: Spyglass Hill

desktopHero.title: Alarm Response
desktopHero.caption: Alarms are grouped by hardware, sensor, system and weather, with the activity feed and map kept in view for triage.
desktopHero.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club

desktopHero.title: Map with station detail panel
desktopHero.caption: A satellite map with a right-hand panel keeps the superintendent on the turf while editing a single station's runtime and amount.

desktopHero.title: Hydraulic setup
desktopHero.caption: Mains, branches and sources are edited as a tree beside the map, so the hydraulic model stays tied to the physical course.
desktopHero.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club; course name visible: Spyglass Hill

desktopSequences.title: Morning Check-In
desktopSequences.story: The superintendent opens Course Report, sees what failed overnight, runs diagnostics on the failing station, flags it, leaves a note for the crew, and sees the note land in the activity feed.

frames.title: Course Report overview
frames.caption: Failed, Under/Over and Running are the three counts that matter at 6 AM, and they lead the screen.
frames.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club

frames.title: Filter to failed stations
frames.caption: One tap on 'Failed' collapses 1,552 stations to the handful that need attention, grouped by area.
frames.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club

frames.title: Run diagnostics and flag the station
frames.caption: Diagnostic results offer an inline flag with a tooltip, turning a test result into a team-visible issue without leaving the modal.

frames.title: Add a note with context
frames.caption: A note modal attached to the station keeps the explanation next to the problem, with room for photos.

frames.title: Issue and note appear in the feed
frames.caption: The flagged station is highlighted in the table and the flag and note appear in the feed, closing the loop.
frames.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club

desktopSequences.title: End of Day Planning
desktopSequences.story: From the Watering Plan, the superintendent reviews holes, adjusts a program, tunes a single station, checks its activity history and records notes for tomorrow.

frames.title: Watering Plan by hole
frames.caption: Holes, programs and stations are alternate lenses on the same plan, with a right panel for history and automation.

frames.title: Adjust a program
frames.caption: Program-level runtime, amount and percent adjust sit in a right panel beside the table, so changes show in context.
frames.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club

frames.title: Adjust a single station
frames.caption: Per-station percent adjust and suspension are available without leaving the table, with last and next values for reference.
frames.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club

frames.title: Station activity history
frames.caption: A dated activity feed with filter shows exactly what changed on a station and who changed it.
frames.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club; staff username visible: chrismacatee

frames.title: Station notes
frames.caption: Notes with photo thumbnails give tomorrow's crew the why behind today's adjustments.
frames.flag: course name visible: Riverside Golf Club; staff username visible: chrismacatee

mobileHero.title: Map with station clusters
mobileHero.caption: Numbered clusters keep 1,800+ stations legible on a phone and resolve to individual pins as you zoom.

mobileHero.title: Map: Near Me
mobileHero.caption: Your position anchors the map, and nearby pins carry station names, status and flag or note badges at a glance.

mobileHero.title: Station list with filters
mobileHero.caption: Quick filters for Near Me, Flags and Notes make the list a to-do queue for walking the course.

mobileHero.title: Station sheet: issue flagged
mobileHero.caption: A bottom sheet puts the flag state and the four field actions within thumb reach: run water, synchronize, note, diagnostics.

mobileHero.title: Map in percent-adjust mode
mobileHero.caption: Switching the map display to percent adjust shows each cluster's adjustment before you touch anything.

mobileSequences.title: Select and percent adjust
mobileSequences.story: In the field, the user enters selection mode, draws around the stations that need attention, opens Actions and applies a percent adjustment without going back to the desktop.

frames.title: Enter selection mode
frames.caption: A bottom bar and a pan/draw toggle make selection a clear, reversible mode.

frames.title: Draw a selection
frames.caption: Drawing a lasso around stations selects them in one gesture, with a live count on the Next button.

frames.title: Choose an action
frames.caption: Every bulk action (start/stop, diagnostic, hold, note, percent adjust) lives in one sheet.

frames.title: Percent adjust form
frames.caption: A sparse form with base, duration and a disabled temporary field keeps a risky change simple.

frames.title: Confirm the adjustment
frames.caption: The Update button only activates once the values are valid, which prevents accidental irrigation changes.

mobileSequences.title: Diagnose, flag and leave a smart note
mobileSequences.story: A user runs diagnostics on a failing station, flags the issue, writes a note with photos, and sees the suspension confirmed.

frames.title: Diagnostic results
frames.caption: Each test row carries a one-tap flag, so a failed check becomes an issue in the same place it was found.

frames.title: Add a note
frames.caption: The note composer opens the keyboard focused, with photos one tap away and a skip option.

frames.title: Note with photos
frames.caption: Attached photos show as thumbnails with expand controls, so evidence travels with the note.
frames.flag: first name visible in note text: Chris

frames.title: Note saved, station suspended
frames.caption: A toast confirms the suspension, while the flag state stays visible on the station sheet.
frames.flag: first name visible in note text: Chris

system.title: Color distribution
system.caption: Mostly light neutrals, with bright color reserved for status and Toro red kept to global chrome.

system.title: Typography: headings and eyebrows
system.caption: One uniwidth typeface (Golos UI) with monospaced numerals gives dense tables stable columns.

system.title: Map pin states
system.caption: A pin matrix covers every status (available, running, disabled, selected) crossed with flag and note badges.

system.title: Table data rows
system.caption: Course Report rows are specified for status, area color bar and values, with hover and tinted states.

details.title: Station status pins
details.caption: Flag and note badges sit above the status disc so both states read at map scale.

details.title: Course Report rows and badges
details.caption: Stacked status icons and tinted count chips make failures and under/over counts scannable in a table.

details.title: Live flow gauge
details.caption: Live GPM sits beside a capacity bar and PSI, so system load is readable at a glance from every screen.
